records.found: Vericel (maker of MACI) reported third-quarter results on 2026-11-05: MACI revenue up 21%, raised full-year guidance, and a possible UK launch in 2027. The registry entry for the phase 3 trial of MACI in ankle defects (people aged 17 to 65, 309 people planned, finishing about 2030) was updated on 2026-11-05. None of this is a trial in worn, older joints, so the wide-use test is not met.

records.found: Vertex's third-quarter release of 2026-11-02 says it has decided to focus on a newer insulin-cell therapy, VX-017, which suits any blood type, rather than zimislecel, which suits blood types A or A/B only; VX-017 is expected to enter pivotal development in 2027. The release (as copied on finviz; the original is on Business Wire) says nothing of a filing for zimislecel, which weighs against the record's 2030 earliest clinic year and its assumption of a filing. The entry also has no mention of VX-017.

findings.what: Vertex Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results (Business Wire): Phase 1/2 trial of VX-017 enrolling and dosing; Vertex 'has decided to focus on accelerating' VX-017 over zimislecel; pivotal development of VX-017 in 2027; Fast Track granted to VX-017; no zimislecel filing mentioned.
Registry record NCT04786262 (zimislecel and VX-017, phase 3 label, 57 people planned) last updated 2026-09-01; outside the window.
Secondary summary of the same release saying Vertex pushes pivotal trials to 2027 (finsee.ai); search summary only.

records.found: A new phase 1 registry entry for a pig kidney-plus-thymus transplant (ChoironeX, NYU Langone, 4 people planned) was updated on 2026-11-02; it was first posted 2026-07-10 and is not among the two trials the record names. On 2026-11-05 a trade-magazine article quoted eGenesis as planning a combined phase 1/2/3 kidney trial (RESTORE) from the first quarter of 2027 and its first pig heart transplant in 2027. None reaches approval, so the clinic rung is not met.

findings.what: Registry record NCT07696962, ChoironeX GalKO porcine thymokidney, phase 1, 4 people planned, NYU Langone recruiting, second site not yet recruiting, start October 2026 (estimated); last updated 2026-11-02, first posted 2026-07-10.
Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News article: eGenesis RESTORE phase 1/2/3 kidney trial expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027; first pig-to-human heart transplant expected in 2027.
Preprint (not peer reviewed): gene-edited pig livers attached outside the body to six monkeys with acute liver failure for 74 to 144 hours; liver function supported but platelets fell sharply.
Registry record NCT06878560 (United Therapeutics kidney, 50 people planned, recruiting) last updated 2026-03-27; outside the window.
